sentences.text: Date of order 10.06.2025

The Police Sub-Inspector of Police, Siddapura Police Station, Bengaluru has filed Police Report against the accused persons alleging that they have committed the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
2. It is the case of the Prosecution that the informant is the wife of the accused No.1.
On 23.10.2012 her marriage was solemnized with the accused No.1.
She was blessed with three kids.
The informant was taken care by this accused for a period of two years.
But, later they started torturing the informant physically and mentally.
The informant has tolerated all the torture of the accused on the thinking that these accused will mend their behaviors one or the other day.
But, however they have not mend their behaviors and accordingly she had been to her mother's house.
On 23.11.2023 these accused came to the informant and started demanding money.
Even these accused have not taken care of her daughter who is suffering from blood cancer.
The informant left with no option had been to the Police Station and lodged the information against the accused persons.
3. Based on the First Information of CW1, the crime was registered in Crime No.307/2023 at Siddapura Police Station.
The accused persons were arrested and released on bail.

On completion of the investigation, the Police Sub-Inspector of Siddapura Police Station, Bengaluru City filed Police Report against the accused persons alleging that they have committed the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
After taking cognizance of the said offence, the process was issued to the accused persons.
The copies of the Police Report and other prosecution papers are furnished to the accused persons under Section 207 of Cr.P.C.

After hearing, since there were grounds for presuming that the accused persons have committed the offence triable by this Court,
charges for the offences has been framed and read over to them in Kannada language.
They have pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
4. To prove the charges framed against the accused, the Prosecution has produced the oral evidence of PW1 and documentary evidences as per Ex.P1 and Ex.P2.

Since, there were no incriminating circumstances appearing in the evidences of the prosecution witnesses against the accused, the examination of the accused under Section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
5. Heard the arguments of learned Senior Assistant Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the accused persons.
Perused the materials available on record.

6. The points for determination are;
1. Whether prosecution has proved beyond all reasonable doubts that the accused persons have committed the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code ?
2. What order or sentence?

sentences.text:
My answers to the above points are as follows:
 Point No.1 : In the Negative,
 Point No.2 :
As per final order for the following:-

REASONS 8. POINT No.1 :- It is the case of the Prosecution that accused No.1 being the husband of the informant and accused No.2 and 3 being the in-laws of the informant tortured the informant physically and mentally.
The information was lodged and after due investigation the Final Report was submitted.
9. To prove the guilt of the accused, the Prosecution has examined CW1/PW1 Shaguftha Ahmadi who is the informant and victim has deposed that she has not lodged any information against these accused.
These accused have not assaulted her nor abused her in a filthy language.
This witness has totally turned hostile to the case of the Prosecution.
This witness is cross-examined by the learned Senior APP.
But, this witness sticked to her own version and has deposed that she was not subjected to any kind of assault or cruelty nor these accused abused her in a filthy language.

When the victim and the informant herself has turned hostile, no purpose will be served in examining the rest of the witnesses and dropped all the witnesses by rejecting the prayer of the learned Senior APP.
Absolutely, there are not evidence to prove the guilt of the accused persons beyond all reasonable doubts.
Hence, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
10. Point No.2:

In view of the Negative findings on the above Point No.1, I proceed to pass the following:-
ORDERS Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C, accused No.1 to 3 are hereby acquitted for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
Their bail bonds and surety bonds will be canceled after appeal period.
(Typed by the Stenographer in the Court Computer on my direct dictation, printout taken, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open court on 10.06.2025)
(SAHEEL AHMED.S.KUNNIBHAVI) II ACJM, Bengaluru City.
